_help: Transparency report on support.html (#where). 'goal' is the monthly target in euros (keep it equal to the Ko-fi goal and tcp_kofi.py --goal). Money received is counted live by tools/server-bridge/tcp_kofi.py and shown by site.js. After each month closes, add {"month": "2026-11", "received": <Ko-fi total>, "spent": <paid out>} here (whole euros; received is the fallback when the API is offline), then run python tools/website/build.py. The reserve is calculated.
